meta.title: Addiction Society — Addiction Data Observatory
meta.description: A data observatory that reads alcohol, drug, gambling and digital addiction as structural signals of society. Monitoring releases from 23 domestic and international sources, building indicators, policy and research archives.

hero.badgeDesc: Data-driven research on the addicted society
hero.line1: Addiction is not a personal <hl>moral failing</hl> —
hero.line2: it is a <hl>structural risk signal</hl> for society.
hero.subtitle: Addiction Society does not treat gambling, gaming, alcohol or digital addiction as merely personal problems. It is a research platform that reads the entire risk system through data — inequality, finance and platform industries, urban and labor structures, and AI — and proposes a new standard for recovery communities.

ministry.title: Korea's addiction response is split across six ministries
ministry.desc: Each type of addiction — alcohol, gambling, internet, gaming, drugs — falls under a different ministry and a different implementing agency.
ministry.quote: "Each ministry operates under different laws, which makes it hard to build a cooperative framework."
ministry.quoteBy: — Ministry of Health and Welfare official, 2025 parliamentary audit
ministry.footnote: With separate legal mandates and data systems, even information sharing is impossible — and no integrated system exists to support a single adolescent continuously from initial counseling through treatment and aftercare.
